verdict.rationale: Wise Business docs confirm global/business payments via API and US bank account details (implying domestic transfers), but no explicit mention of ACH or wire transfer mechanics, batch vendor payments, or approval workflows for finance teams. Community reports also show real friction — sudden change of US account/routing details with no notice (wise-comm-3) and a business account being fully blocked over a category mismatch (wise-comm-6) — which undercuts reliability for ongoing vendor payments. missing for 10: explicit ACH/wire terminology, vendor batch-payment/approval workflow evidence, and confirmation that account-detail volatility doesn't disrupt recurring vendor payments.
